The full test suite passes: **270 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors**.

## Summary

The spec required duplicate detection to ignore letter case and surrounding/repeated whitespace. The duplicate checks live in `OwnerRestControllerV1` (telephone and email uniqueness — V2 has no duplicate logic).

I made the comparison canonicalize both sides before matching, in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- Added a `normalize(String)` helper that strips surrounding whitespace, collapses any run of internal whitespace to a single space (`\\s+` → `" "`), and lower-cases with `Locale.ROOT`. So `"  john   smith "` and `"John Smith"` both normalize to `"john smith"`.
- `isDuplicateTelephone` and `isDuplicateEmail` now compare `normalize(existing)` against `normalize(candidate)`, keeping the existing "blank email is never a duplicate" behavior.
- Added the `java.util.Locale` import.

All existing and checkpoint tests (including the cp05 case-insensitivity tests) pass.
